title: Monotonicity in the acceptance threshold
statement: Let $p,q:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $q(n)\leq p(n)$ for every $n$. Every language decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine whose probability of producing the correct answer on inputs of length $n$ is at least $p(n)$ is also decidable in polynomial time with that probability at least $q(n)$.
